A pagan city at the springs of the Jorda: Obodo ndị mba ọzọ n'isi iyi Jọdan, n'okpuru nnukwu mgbidi okwute. N'ebe a, n'ihu ụlọ arụsị Pan, Pita kwupụtara na Jizọs bụ Kraịst.
Basilica of the Transfiguration, Mount T: Basilika nke Ngbanwe Ebube, ugwu Tabọ
The Gospels say \"a high mountain\" (Mar: Oziọma kwuru «ugwu dị elu» (Mark 9:2). Site n'oge Origen na Onye Nsọ Sirịl nke Jerusalem, ọdịnala na-akpọ Tabọ; basilika ndị Fransiskan na-achọ elu ya mma.
A town of black basalt in the hills abov: Obodo nkume ojii n'obere ugwu dị n'elu Kapanaọm, otu n'ime ebe «o mere ọtụtụ ọrụ ebube ya» (Matthew 11:20-21).
The village of Martha, Mary and Lazarus: Obodo nta Mata, Meri na Lazarọs n'akụkụ nke ọzọ nke Ugwu Oliv. N'ebe ahụ, ndị njem nsọ na-eleta ili Lazarọs na ụka ndị Fransiskan.
The pool at the south end of the City of: Ọdọ mmiri dị na nsọtụ ndịda Obodo Devid, nke ọwa mmiri Hezekaịa na-enye mmiri. A chọtara steepụ ya nke narị afọ mbụ n'afọ 2004.
Saint Helena built the Eleona church ove: Onye Nsọ Helena wuru ụka Eleona n'elu ọgba ebe, dịka ọdịnala si kwuo, Onyenwe anyị na-ezi ndị na-eso ụzọ ya ihe. Ekpere Nna Anyị na-achọ mgbidi ya mma n'asụsụ karịrị 140.
John says only that it was a town near t: Jọn kwuru naanị na ọ bụ obodo dị nso n'ọzara (John 11:54). Ọdịnala na-etinye ya na Taybeh, obodo ndị Kraịst taa.
The oasis city on the road up to Jerusal: Obodo ebe mmiri dị n'ọzara n'ụzọ na-arịgo Jerusalem. Osisi sikamọ dị n'obodo na-echetara anyị Zakiọs.
Franciscan church of Bethphage, Mount of: Ụka ndị Fransiskan nke Betfaje, Ugwu Oliv
The village where the disciples found th: Obodo nta ebe ndị na-eso ụzọ hụrụ nwa ịnyịnya ibu. Njem Ụbọchị Nkwụ nke Nzukọ Nsọ Jerusalem ka na-amalite n'ebe ahụ kwa afọ.
Church of Dominus Flevit, Mount of Olive: Ụka Dominus Flevit («Onyenwe anyị kwara ákwá»), Ugwu Oliv
A small church shaped like a teardrop, l: Obere ụka yiri ụzọ anya mmiri, na-ele obodo ahụ anya n'ofe ndagwurugwu Kidrọn, na-echetara anyị ebe «Onyenwe anyị kwara ákwá».
The early Church honoured Mount Zion as: Nzukọ Nsọ mbụ sọpụrụ ugwu Zayọn dịka ebe Nri Anyasị Ikpeazụ na Pentikọst. Ụlọ nke taa n'ụdị Gọtik sitere n'oge ndị Krusedi na ndị Fransiskan.
Church of All Nations, at the foot of th: Basilika nke Mba Niile, n'ụkwụ Ugwu Oliv
The garden of ancient olive trees, with: Ubi osisi oliv ochie, ya na Basilika nke Mba Niile e wuru n'elu okwute ebe Onyenwe anyị kpere ekpere n'oké ihe mgbu.
Saint Peter in Gallicantu, Mount Zion: Onye Nsọ Pita na Gallicantu, Ugwu Zayọn
The Church of Saint Peter in Gallicantu: Ụka Onye Nsọ Pita na Gallicantu («mgbe ọkụkọ kwara») na-echetara anyị ọjụjụ Pita na abalị Onyenwe anyị nọrọ n'ụlọ mkpọrọ. Ndị ọzọ na-etinye ụlọ onyeisi nchụàjà nso Cenacolo.
Church of the Flagellation and Ecce Homo: Ụka Ịpịa Ụtarị na Ọnụ Ụzọ Ecce Homo, Via Dolorosa
The Way of the Cross begins at the Anton: Ụzọ Obe na-amalite na Ebe Mgbachitere Antonia, ebe ndị Fransiskan na-elekọta ụka Ịpịa Ụtarị na nke Ikpe. Ọtụtụ ndị ọkà mmụta na-etinye Paịlet kama n'obí Herọd nso Ọnụ Ụzọ Jafa.
Since the Middle Ages pilgrims have pray: Kemgbe Oge Etiti, ndị njem nsọ na-ekpe Ọnọdụ Ụzọ Obe n'okporo ụzọ a, site na Ebe Mgbachitere Antonia ruo Kalvari; kwa Fraịde ndị Fransiskan na-edu njem ahụ. Ụzọ kpọmkwem Onyenwe anyị gara dabere n'ebe Paịlet kpere ya ikpe.
Christians have honoured this place sinc: Ndị Kraịst asọpụrụla ebe a kemgbe ọgbọ mbụ; Onye Nsọ Helena na Kọnstantaịn wuru basilika n'elu okwute Kalvari na ili tọgbọrọ chakoo, ndị Fransiskan na-ejekwa ozi n'ebe ahụ taa.
Luke gives the distance as about seven m: Luk kwuru ogologo stadia iri isii site na Jerusalem (Luke 24:13). A na-asọpụrụ ebe atọ: Emmaus Nicopolis, nke e gosiri ebe a; El-Qubeibeh, nke ndị Fransiskan na-elekọta; na Abu Ghosh.
Church of the Primacy of Saint Peter, Ta: Ụka Ọchịchị Onye Nsọ Pita, Tabgha
A small basalt church on the water's edg: Obere ụka nkume ojii n'akụkụ mmiri, e wuru gburugburu okwute a na-akpọ «Mensa Christi» (Tebụl Kraịst), ebe, dịka ọdịnala si kwuo, o doziri nri ụtụtụ maka ndịozi.
Since at least the fifth century the Chu: Kemgbe narị afọ nke ise ma ọ bụ tupu mgbe ahụ, Nzukọ Nsọ Jerusalem na-asọpụrụ ili a n'ụkwụ Ugwu Oliv, nso Getsemani, dịka ebe e buliri Nne Chineke n'eluigwe. Ụlọ ndị mọnk nke Ụra n'ugwu Zayọn na-echeta ụra ya; ọdịnala ọzọ kwuru na o biri afọ ikpeazụ ya na Onye Nsọ Jọn na Efesọs.
Chapel of the Ascension, Mount of Olives: Obere Ụka Ọrịgo n'Eluigwe, Ugwu Oliv
Luke says He led them \"as far as Bethan: Luk kwuru na o duru ha «ruo Betani» (Luke 24:50), Ọrụ Ndịozi kwukwara na ha si n'Ugwu Oliv lọta (Acts 1:12). Obere ụka dị n'elu ugwu na-echekwa nkume a na-asọpụrụ dịka nke nwere akara ụkwụ ya ikpeazụ.
The angel Gabriel greets the Virgin Mary: Mmụọ ozi Gebriel kelere Nwa-agbọghọ jupụtara n'amara. Mgbe ọ zara «ka ọ dịrị m dịka okwu gị si dị», Okwu ahụ ghọrọ mmadụ n'afọ ya.
Mary carries Our Lord to her kinswoman E: Meri bu Onyenwe anyị gaa n'ụlọ onye ikwu ya Elizabet. Jọn wụliri elu n'afọ n'ọṅụ, Elizabet kpọrọ ya «Nne Onyenwe m», Meri wee bụọ Magnificat.
Our Lord is born of the Virgin Mary in t: N'obodo Devid, a mụrụ Onyenwe anyị site na Nwa-agbọghọ Nsọ Meri, e ji akwa kechie ya, tọgbọ ya n'ebe a na-enye anụmanụ nri, n'ihi na ha enweghị ọnọdụ n'ụlọ ndị ọbịa.
The Shepherds Hear the Angels: Ndị ọzụzụ atụrụ nụrụ ndị mmụọ ozi
An angel announces \"a savior who is Mes: Mmụọ ozi kpọsara «Onye Nzọpụta, onye bụ Kraịst Onyenwe anyị», usuu ndị eluigwe wee bụọ abụ «Otuto dịrị Chineke n'ebe kachasị elu». Ndị ọzụzụ atụrụ ji ọsọ gaa ịchọ Nwa ahụ.
The Magi Adore the Child: Ndị amamihe kpọrọ Nwa ahụ isi ala
Wise men from the East follow His star,: Ndị amamihe si n'ọwụwa anyanwụ soro kpakpando ya, hụ Nwa ahụ na Meri nne ya, ha wee nye ya ọlaedo, ihe nsure ọkụ na-esi ísì ụtọ na mia.
Mary and Joseph present the Child to the: Meri na Josef chere Onyenwe anyị Nwa ahụ n'ihu Chineke. Simiọn kuru ya n'aka ya, kpọọ ya «ìhè ga-enwu mba niile», gwakwa Meri na mma agha ga-amapu obi ya.
Warned in a dream, Saint Joseph rises by: Mgbe a dọrọ ya aka ná ntị na nrọ, Onye Nsọ Josef biliri n'abalị, kpọrọ Nwa ahụ na nne ya gaa Ijipt, pụọ n'aka Herọd, ka okwu ahụ wee mezuo: «Esi m n'Ijipt kpọọ nwa m» (Hosea 11:1).
After Herod's death the Holy Family sett: Mgbe Herọd nwụsịrị, Ezinụlọ Nsọ biri na Nazaret, «nwa ahụ wee too, nwee ike, jupụta n'amamihe, amara Chineke dịkwa n'ahụ ya».
At twelve He stays behind in Jerusalem a: Mgbe ọ dị afọ iri na abụọ, ọ nọgidere na Jerusalem mgbe Ememme Ngabiga gasịrị. N'ụbọchị nke atọ, Meri na Josef chọtara ya n'etiti ndị nkuzi: «Ọ bụ na unu amaghị na ọ dị m mkpa ịnọ n'ihe Nna m?»
For some thirty years He lives at Nazare: Ihe dị ka afọ iri atọ ọ biri na Nazaret, na-erubere Meri na Josef isi, na-arụ ọrụ ọkwa nkà, na-etokwa n'amamihe, n'ogo na n'amara n'ihu Chineke na mmadụ.
John baptizes Him in the Jordan. The hea: Jọn mere ya baptizim na Jọdan. Eluigwe meghere, Mmụọ Nsọ rịdatara dịka nduru, olu Nna wee sị: «Nke a bụ Ọkpara m m hụrụ n'anya, onye obi dị m ụtọ nke ukwuu n'ebe ọ nọ.»
Led by the Spirit into the desert, He fa: Mmụọ duru ya gaa n'ọzara, ebe o bu ọnụ ụbọchị iri anọ na abalị iri anọ, o jikwa Okwu Chineke merie ọnwụnwa ekwensu.
John points Him out: \"Behold, the Lamb: Jọn gosiri ya: «Lee Nwa Atụrụ Chineke.» Andru kpọtara nwanne ya Saịmọn, onye Jizọs kpọrọ Kefas, ya bụ Pita; Filip na Natanael sooro ya.
At His mother's word, \"Do whatever he t: Site n'okwu Nne ya, «Mee ihe ọ bụla ọ gwara unu», ọ gbanwere mmiri ka ọ ghọọ mmanya, ihe ịrịbama mbụ ya, ndị na-eso ụzọ ya wee malite ikwere na ya.
The Wedding Feast at Cana: Jizọs gosipụtara onwe ya n'agbamakwụkwọ na Kena
The First Passover: Zeal for His Father': Ememme Ngabiga mbụ: ịnụ ọkụ n'obi maka ụlọ Nna
He drives the money changers from the Te: Ọ chụpụrụ ndị na-agbanwe ego n'Ụlọ Nsọ, n'abalị ọ kụziiri Nikodimọs na mmadụ ga-amụ ọzọ site na mmiri na Mmụọ. «N'ihi na Chineke hụrụ ụwa n'anya nke ukwuu, nke mere o nyere Ọkpara ọ mụrụ naanị ya.»
Weary at noon, He asks a Samaritan woman: Ike gwụrụ ya n'ehihie, ọ rịọrọ otu nwanyị Sameria mmiri ọṅụṅụ, o wee nye ya mmiri ndụ, «isi iyi mmiri na-asọpụta ruo ndụ ebighị ebi». Ọtụtụ n'obodo ya kwere.
A royal official from Capernaum begs Him: Otu onye ọrụ eze si Kapanaọm rịọrọ ya ka ọ bịa. «Laa, nwa gị dị ndụ.» N'otu awa ahụ nwa ahụ gbakere.
In the synagogue He reads Isaiah, \"The: N'ụlọ nzukọ ọ gụrụ n'akwụkwọ Aịzaya, «Mmụọ Onyenwe anyị dị n'ahụ m», wee sị: «Taa ka Akwụkwọ Nsọ a mezuru.» Ndị obodo ya kpọọrọ ya gaa n'ọnụ ugwu, ma o si n'etiti ha gafee, laa.
The Franciscans honour the Mount of the: Ndị Fransiskan na-asọpụrụ Ugwu Mwụli na ndịda obodo ahụ dịka ugwu e kwuru na Luke 4:29.
Leaving Nazareth, He makes His home in C: Mgbe ọ hapụrụ Nazaret, o biri na Kapanaọm n'akụkụ oké osimiri, malite ikwusa ozi: «Oge ahụ eruola, Alaeze Chineke dị nso. Chegharịanụ, kwerekwanụ n'Oziọma.»
Repentance and trust in God: Nchegharị na ntụkwasị obi na Chineke
By the shore He calls Simon and Andrew,: N'ụsọ mmiri ọ kpọrọ Saịmọn na Andru, Jems na Jọn: «Sorọnụ m, m ga-eme unu ndị na-akụ azụ mmadụ.» Mgbe ha kụchara azụ dị ebube, ha hapụrụ ihe niile wee soro ya.
He teaches with authority in the synagog: Ọ na-ezi ihe n'ike n'ụlọ nzukọ, chụpụ mmụọ na-adịghị ọcha n'ahụ mmadụ, kulie nne nwunye Pita n'ahụ ọkụ, mgbe anyanwụ dakwara obodo niile gbakọtara n'ọnụ ụzọ.
The Paralytic and the Call of Matthew: Onye ahụ mkpọnwụ na ọkpụkpọ Matiu
Friends lower a paralyzed man through th: Ndị enyi wedatara onye ahụ mkpọnwụ site n'elu ụlọ; Jizọs gbaghaara ya mmehie ya, nye ya iwu ka ọ gaa ije. Mgbe ahụ ọ kpọrọ Livaị, Matiu, n'ebe a na-anakọta ụtụ: «Soro m.»
He teaches the Beatitudes, \"Blessed are: Ọ kụziri Ngọzi, «Ngọzi na-adịrị ndị ogbenye n'ime mmụọ, n'ihi na Alaeze eluigwe bụ nke ha», iwu ọhụrụ nke ịhụnanya, na ekpere Nna Anyị.
The Centurion's Servant: Onye ohu ọchịagha narị ndị agha
A Roman centurion says, \"Lord, I am not: Otu ọchịagha narị ndị agha Rom sịrị: «Onyenwe m, erughị m ka ị bata n'okpuru ụlọ m, kama kwuo naanị otu okwu.» Nzukọ Nsọ na-ekwughachi okwu ya tupu ịnata Oriri Nsọ na Mass ọ bụla.
Moved with pity for a widow burying her: O meere nwanyị di ya nwụrụ ebere, bụ onye na-eli naanị nwa ya, metụ ihe e ji bu ozu aka: «Nwa okorobịa, a sị m gị, bilie!» o wee nyeghachi ya nne ya.
At a feast in Jerusalem He heals a man i: N'otu ememme na Jerusalem ọ gwọrọ nwoke rịarala ọrịa afọ iri atọ na asatọ: «Bilie, chiri ute gị, jee ije.»
A violent squall swamps the boat while H: Oké ifufe mere ka mmiri jupụta n'ụgbọ mmiri, ebe ọ na-ehi ụra. Ọ baara ifufe mba: «Gbachie nkịtị! Dajụọ!» nnukwu ịdị jụụ wee dị. «Onye bụ onye a, nke ifufe na oké osimiri na-erubere isi?»
On the far shore He frees a man tormente: N'ofe nke ọzọ ọ gwọrọ nwoke ọtụtụ mmụọ na-adịghị ọcha na-esogbu, ndị e zigara n'ìgwè ezi. Nwoke ahụ rịọrọ ya ka o soro ya, ma e zigara ya ka ọ kpọsaa ihe Onyenwe anyị meere ya.
A woman is healed by touching His cloak,: Otu nwanyị gbakere mgbe o metụrụ uwe ya aka, o jidekwa aka ada Jaịrọs nwụrụ anwụ: «Talita kum», ya bụ: «Nwa agbọghọ, a sị m gị, bilie!»
With five loaves and two fish He feeds t: Site n'ogbe achịcha ise na azụ abụọ o nyere igwe mmadụ nri, lelie anya n'eluigwe, kelee ekele, nyawaa achịcha ahụ, ha wee chịkọta nkata iri na abụọ jupụtara n'iberibe fọdụrụ.
In the fourth watch of the night He come: N'oge nche ikpeazụ nke abalị ọ bịakwutere ha na-eje ije n'elu oké osimiri. Pita jere ije izute ya, malite imikpu, tie mkpu: «Onyenwe anyị, zọpụta m!»
In the synagogue at Capernaum He teaches: N'ụlọ nzukọ Kapanaọm ọ kụziri: «Abụ m achịcha ndụ… Onye na-eri anụ ahụ m ma na-aṅụ ọbara m nwere ndụ ebighị ebi.» Pita zara: «Onyenwe anyị, ònye ka anyị ga-agakwuru?»
A Gentile mother begs Him to heal her da: Otu nne si mba ọzọ rịọrọ ya maka ada ya: «Ọbụna nkịta na-eri iberibe na-esi na tebụl ndị nwe ha ada.» «Nwanyị, okwukwe gị dị ukwuu!»
Ephphatha, and Four Thousand Fed: Efata, na inye puku mmadụ anọ nri
He opens the ears of a deaf man, \"Ephph: O meghere ntị onye ntị chiri, «Efata», ya bụ «Meghee!», o jikwa ogbe achịcha asaa nye puku mmadụ anọ ndị nọnyere ya ụbọchị atọ nri.
Pharisees and Sadducees ask for a sign f: Ndị Farisii na ndị Sadusii rịọrọ ya ihe ịrịbama si n'eluigwe. Ọ gwara ha na a gaghị enye ha ihe ịrịbama ọzọ ma ọ bụghị ihe ịrịbama Jona.
He leads a blind man out of the village: O jidere onye ìsì n'aka, duru ya pụọ n'obodo nta ahụ, bikwasị ya aka ugboro abụọ, ruo mgbe ọ hụrụ ihe niile nke ọma.
\"Who do you say that I am?\" Peter answ: «Ma unu, ònye ka unu sị na m bụ?» Pita zara: «Ị bụ Kraịst, Ọkpara Chineke dị ndụ.» «Ị bụ Pita, n'elu okwute a ka m ga-ewu Nzukọ Nsọ m… M ga-enye gị mkpịsị ugodi Alaeze eluigwe.»
Before Peter, James and John His face sh: N'ihu Pita, Jems na Jọn, ihu ya nwuru dịka anyanwụ, Mosis na Elaịja na-agwa ya okwu, Nna wee sị: «Nke a bụ Ọkpara m m hụrụ n'anya… Gee ya ntị.»
He reproaches the towns where most of Hi: Ọ baara obodo ndị o mere ọtụtụ ọrụ ebube ya mba, Korazin, Betsaida na Kapanaọm, n'ihi na ha echegharịghị.
Peter finds the Temple tax in the mouth: Pita chọtara ụtụ Ụlọ Nsọ n'ọnụ azụ. Mgbe ahụ Jizọs mere ka nwatakịrị guzo n'etiti ha: «Ọ bụrụ na unu agbanweghị ghọọ dịka obere ụmụaka, unu agaghị abanye n'Alaeze eluigwe.»
He teaches in the Temple courts, \"Let a: N'ogige Ụlọ Nsọ ọ kụziri: «Ọ bụrụ na akpịrị na-akpọ onye ọ bụla nkụ, ya bịakwute m ṅụọ», gbaghara nwanyị e jidere n'ịkwa iko, «Laa, site ugbu a emehiekwala», wee kpọsaa: «Abụ m ìhè ụwa.»
He smears clay on the eyes of a man blin: O tere apịtị n'anya nwoke a mụrụ ìsì, zipụ ya ka ọ gaa saa ahụ n'ọdọ mmiri Siloam. Ọ lọghachiri na-ahụ ụzọ, kpọọ ya isi ala: «Onyenwe anyị, ekwere m.»
Martha welcomes Him while Mary sits at H: Mata nabatara ya, Meri nọdụkwara n'ụkwụ ya na-ege ntị. «Meri ahọrọla òkè dị mma, a gaghị anapụkwa ya ya.»
Luke says only \"a village\"; John names: Luk kwuru naanị «n'otu obodo nta»; Jọn kpọrọ Betani dịka ụlọ Mata na Meri (John 11:1).
Lord, Teach Us to Pray: Onyenwe anyị, kụziere anyị ikpe ekpere
When a disciple asks Him to teach them t: Mgbe otu n'ime ndị na-eso ụzọ rịọrọ ya ka ọ kụziere ha ikpe ekpere, o nyere ha ekpere Nna Anyị.
Luke does not name the place; tradition: Luk akpọghị ebe ọ bụla; ọdịnala na-echeta ya n'ọgba Eleona n'Ugwu Oliv. Matiu nyere ekpere a n'Ozizi n'Ugwu (Matthew 6:9-13).
Walking in the portico of Solomon in win: Ọ na-eje ije n'ọnụ ụzọ mbata Solomọn n'oge oyi, wee sị: «Atụrụ m na-anụ olu m… Mụ na Nna bụ otu.»
Ọ laghachiri n'ebe Jọn na-eme baptizim na mbụ. Ọ kụziri na ihe Chineke jikọtara, mmadụ ekwela ka ọ kewaa, ọ gọziri ụmụaka: «Hapụnụ ụmụntakịrị ka ha bịakwute m.»
\"I am the resurrection and the life.\": «Abụ m mbilite n'ọnwụ na ndụ.» Jizọs kwara ákwá n'ili enyi ya, mgbe ahụ ọ tiri mkpu n'oké olu: «Lazarọs, pụta!» onye nwụrụ anwụ wee pụta, akwa ka kechiri ya.
As the council plots His death, He withd: Mgbe Kansụl Ukwu gbara izu igbu ya, o zoro ezo ya na ndị na-eso ụzọ ya n'obodo dị nso n'ọzara a na-akpọ Ifrem.

The Rosary grew out of the prayer of the: Rosarị malitere n'ekpere Nzukọ Nsọ. Ndị mọnk na-abụ abụ ọma 150, ndị Kraịst na-amaghị agụ akwụkwọ na-ekpe Nna Anyị 150, mgbe e mesịrị Ekele Meri 150, na-agụ ha n'eriri mkpụrụ: «Abụ Ọma Meri».
By a beloved tradition, the Blessed Virg: Dịka ọdịnala a hụrụ n'anya si kwuo, Nwa-agbọghọ Nsọ Meri nyere Onye Nsọ Dọminik Rosarị na Prouille, na France, ná mmalite narị afọ nke iri na atọ, iji nyere ya aka n'ozizi ya megide nkuzi ụgha ndị Albigensian. Otu ya, Otu Ndị Nkwusa, gbasara ya n'ụwa Kraịst niile, na narị afọ nke iri na ise Onye A Gọziri Agọzi Alan nke La Roche, onye Dọminikan, mere ka nsọpụrụ a dị ọhụrụ ma hiwe otu Rosarị mbụ.
Pope Saint Pius V, himself a Dominican,: Onye Nsọ Pope Pius V, onye Dọminikan ya onwe ya, nyere Rosarị ụdị ya a na-ahụkarị nke ihe omimi iri na ise, nke Ọṅụ, nke Mwute na nke Ebube, n'afọ 1569. Mgbe mmeri Lepanto mere na 7 Ọktọba 1571, nke e nwetara mgbe ụwa Kraịst niile na-ekpe Rosarị, o mere ụbọchị ahụ ememme Meri nke Mmeri, nke bụ ncheta Nwa-agbọghọ Nsọ Meri nke Rosarị taa. Na Lourdes na Fatima, Nwa-agbọghọ ahụ n'onwe ya bịara jiri rosarị, rịọkwa ka a na-ekpe ya kwa ụbọchị.
On October 16, 2002, Pope Saint John Pau: Na 16 Ọktọba 2002, Onye Nsọ Pope Jọn Pọl nke Abụọ tinyere ihe omimi ise nke Ìhè, si na ndụ Onyenwe anyị n'ihu ọha, n'akwụkwọ ozi ndịozi ya Rosarium Virginis Mariae, ka Rosarị bụrụ «nchịkọta Oziọma». N'ihe omimi ọ bụla anyị na-atụgharị uche n'ihu Kraịst na-ele anya site n'anya Nne ya.
